author: Aldrin Payopay
null_means: undefined correlation (zero residual variance) or diagnostic not computed

F2_false_positives.rule: detections at or below the upper 95% binomial bound for a 5% rate on every field control and the iid statistic control; size at most 0.10 on the AR(1) control

recorded_stranger_as_own.note: diagnostic only: the three column statistics share one matrix

F4_robustness.tolerance_rule: violations <= max(1, ceil(0.05 * runs measurable under both))
